scope: Independent read-only audit of current raw results and prior physical packs. Final closure fixes not evaluated. Only this report written.
original39_digest_method: sha256(canonical sorted JSON map of relative case path to exact file sha256)

rules: Keep original39 files and166/205 occurrence totals unchanged. A duplicate original label occurrence still counts.
Maintain both original-label ledger and full RetrievalPlan facet obligation ledger; explicit input facets are an additional useful subtotal.
Classify from facet semantics and independent audit before selection result. Never classify only missing labels.
An Expand appended raw label binds specifically to the expansion facet. Base labels bind to original Prepare facets. Same path can represent distinct semantic and lexical obligations.
EXPECTED_LABEL_WAS_WRONG requires independent source+architecture+profile+policy+contract+test audit. Record original and corrected labels and proof. Never derive expected from observed route.
Verify exact or independently reviewed allowlisted route layers, not only expected subset.
No supported mandatory miss may be reclassified from observed absence. No NOT_APPLICABLE waiver without independent proof.

SUPPORTED_REQUIRED: current admitted source/path/symbol evidence found for each original occurrence
every supported required FacetID selected, including generated route/policy facets
hash/span/snapshot provenance verified; appropriate claim authority; no stale evidence
UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTIC: UNSUPPORTED_QUERY or QUERY_UNSUPPORTED bound to facet ID
facet coverage UNSUPPORTED; pack not COMPLETE
unsupported facet has no semantic evidence; lexical same-file bytes do not prove semantic obligation
lexical fallback has separate facet identity and explicit semantic unsupported limitation
SECURITY_EXCLUDED: safe scanner/pinned omission ledger exact source/path SECRET_CONTENT_EXCLUDED
required facet exclusion coverage and REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_EXCLUDED_BY_SECURITY bound to exact facet/source/path
excluded bytes absent from corpus/pack/logs/reports; no sibling fallback
AUTH_SAFE_REGRESSION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED if owner must supply safe authoritative equivalent
MISSING_BUSINESS_CONTRACT: complete bounded relevant source search; no limits/unreadable/NOT_VERIFIED portrayed as proven absence
MISSING_METRIC_CONTRACT or equivalent specific business missing diagnostic with facet and safe provenance
MISSING_OWNER_CONTRACT: independent unresolved ownership proof, not acquisition failure
AMBIGUOUS_ROUTE: independent genuine ambiguous intent proof plus explicit AMBIGUOUS_TASK_INTENT
known source owner and supported evidence labels retained; route ambiguity alone does not convert evidence to missing owner class

final_classification.failure_gate: Any wrong route/owner/layer, safety violation, silent or unsupported mandatory miss, false COMPLETE, undiagnosed ambiguity or security exclusion prevents READY.
final_classification.VALID_BLOCKED: Actual blocked pack with independently admissible blocker proof; supported mandatory evidence still satisfies readiness gates.
final_classification.VALID_UNSUPPORTED: Primary requested capability unavailable with explicit UNSUPPORTED coverage and no semantic overclaim; separately prove supported context evidence.
final_classification.VALID_PARTIAL: Supported required evidence complete, explicit independently justified partial/unsupported/security/business/owner limitations, correct provenance and authority.
final_classification.PASS: Accepted supported retrieval. Actual pack status remains separately reported; document if unrelated source limitation leaves pack PARTIAL.
final_classification.warning: Do not classify all PARTIAL statuses as valid solely from their status; independently prove the applicable limitations.

existing_test_weaknesses.finding: LayerMatch checks expected subset only; incorrect extra layers can pass.
Raw166 excludes missing-grade and unsupported-callers Prepare facets. Full plan facet ledger catches these.
Safety accepts any REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_*; NOT_VERIFIED/UNREADABLE/OMITTED_BY_LIMIT do not prove missing business contracts.
UNSUPPORTED_QUERY can omit source/path: join through facet ID. Security diagnostics must match exact required source/path.
File-level raw label can be found lexically while semantic facet remains unsupported; retain semantic ledger.
File-level must label may pass despite missing required qualified definition. Full facet ledger prevents it.
Evidence presence alone cannot establish official business/metric authority; preserve conflicts and evaluate requested claim authority.
Raw score omits duplicate ratio. Report selected occurrences and stable unique source/span identities; never deduplicate original expected denominator.

regression_requirements: category stays semantic unsupported after same-file lexical evidence selected
zero-must unsupported-callers and unlabelled missing-grade facet still diagnosed
exact Auth exclusion cannot be waived with exclusion elsewhere or sibling test
business absence is not proved after truncated acquisition
unexpected extra layer fails reviewed route acceptance
original39 hashes and166/205 denominator assertion fail on mutation/drop
supported miss cannot automatically become unsupported/security/businessmissing

requested_work_vs_dependency_inspection.version_requirement: wave1-capability-acceptance/v2 must explicitly declare whether expected route layers represent requested implementation work or all evidence inspection layers. Do not silently reinterpret original_layers.
requested_work_vs_dependency_inspection.route_rule: Requested write/implementation intent determines owner and route layer. Read-only dependency/contract/test evidence from additional layers does not automatically make task multi-layer. Conversely an explicit requested implementation action in several layers needs independent proof and corresponding routes.
requested_work_vs_dependency_inspection.audit_binding: HTTP-add -> HTTP, NBA -> usecase, NATS -> message amendments require independent audit references proving requested work and explaining domain/usecase/dependency paths as inspection. Retain original labels and reasons as EXPECTED_LABEL_WAS_WRONG when justified.
requested_work_vs_dependency_inspection.generic_source_anchor_rule: Qualified Go declaration or AST call-syntax anchors can prove lexical presence and architecture layer of a containing admitted file; they do not prove resolved receiver type, dynamic dispatch, callgraph, or semantic ownership. Report this limitation and preserve type-aware unsupported capability.
requested_work_vs_dependency_inspection.acceptance_separation: Validate supported evidence across all relevant layers regardless of route write-layer count. Cross-service admitted sources remain read-only; dependency inspection never adds foreign write owner.
